name: garry-ai
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Garry.AI instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Garry.AI tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Garry.AI through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Garry.AI Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Garry.AI only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
